$comment: Cinematic anti-AI fingerprints. Extends v5 authenticity_fingerprints.json. Consumed by QA gates.

fingerprints.title: Random floating 3D blob
fingerprints.description: Metallic/chrome/glass abstract shape in the hero with no content association.
fingerprints.why_ai: 3D equivalent of gradient glow. Signals 3D was added without deciding what it should show.

detection.scene_signal: single abstract primitive in hero WebGL canvas with no product/brand association

fingerprints.correction: Either the 3D shows the product, or it is removed.

fingerprints.title: Endless object rotation
fingerprints.description: requestAnimationFrame spin at constant speed with no interaction dependency.
fingerprints.why_ai: No cinematographic intention. Object moves because code can make it move.

detection.js_signal: rotation.y += constant in animation loop with no scroll/interaction dependency

fingerprints.correction: Choose start and end angle. Make object respond to scroll or hover, not time.

fingerprints.title: Chrome/glass object as hero
fingerprints.description: Reflective/refractive object with dramatic HDRI when the product is not chrome/glass.
fingerprints.why_ai: Chrome and glass are default demo materials in every 3D tutorial.

detection.scene_signal: environment map reflection on material unrelated to actual product

fingerprints.correction: Material must match the product. Matte product = matte 3D.

fingerprints.title: Meaningless particle field
fingerprints.description: Thousands of points drifting without data, interaction, or narrative.
fingerprints.why_ai: Particles are the background-grid-overlay of 3D. Technically trivial, visually noisy, narratively empty.

detection.scene_signal: PointsMaterial or particle system with no data source or interaction

fingerprints.correction: Particles justified only for data (point cloud), physics (smoke with source), or counted entities.

fingerprints.title: Meaningless WebGL background
fingerprints.description: Full-page shader or Three.js canvas as background behind text with no interaction or content purpose.
fingerprints.why_ai: Cinematic version of CSS gradient background. GPU for what CSS or nothing should do.

detection.layout_signal: full-viewport WebGL canvas behind text with no scroll/interaction dependency

fingerprints.correction: CSS/SVG for simple backgrounds. Calm whitespace for atmosphere.

fingerprints.title: 3D on every section
fingerprints.description: Multiple decorative 3D canvases across the page.
fingerprints.why_ai: 3D equivalent of every section animates. Flattens hierarchy.

detection.layout_signal: more than two WebGL contexts on same page with purely decorative purpose

fingerprints.correction: One 3D moment per page typical. Two maximum with justification.

fingerprints.title: Every section is pinned scroll sequence
fingerprints.description: Entire page is series of pinned sticky sections with scroll-scrubbed animation. No flowing content.
fingerprints.why_ai: Scroll hijacking at scale. Page becomes a slide deck.

detection.layout_signal: more than 50% of page height is pinned/sticky scroll-driven animation

fingerprints.correction: Maximum one-two pinned sequences per page. Rest is flowing content.

fingerprints.title: Generated video with temporal artifacts shipped
fingerprints.description: AI-generated video with visible flickering, morphing, deformed anatomy, inconsistent geometry.
fingerprints.why_ai: Quality gate was skipped. Literally AI-generated with visible artifacts.
fingerprints.correction: Regenerate, find better source, or drop to static image.

fingerprints.title: Frame sequence for simple transition
fingerprints.description: 60+ frame sequence for what CSS transition could handle.
fingerprints.why_ai: Choosing the heaviest medium for the lightest job.

detection.content_signal: first and last frame differ only by achievable CSS transform

fingerprints.title: Scroll video with no narrative progression
fingerprints.description: Video scrubbed by scroll but content has no meaningful progression.
fingerprints.why_ai: Scroll control is a technology demonstration without narrative purpose.

detection.content_signal: scrubbing start to end reveals no build, reveal, or transformation

fingerprints.correction: If ambient, play as <video> or use static image.

fingerprints.title: AI-generated filler imagery
fingerprints.description: Generated images placed because the section needed an image, not because the image communicates something.
fingerprints.why_ai: Image decision was fill the space rather than show something.

detection.content_signal: generic abstract/stock-like generated image with no product or content specificity

fingerprints.correction: Show something real and specific, or remove the image.

fingerprints.title: Inconsistent asset world
fingerprints.description: Different visual treatments across sections with no coherent visual language.
fingerprints.why_ai: Each asset sourced independently with no Asset DNA.

detection.visual_signal: lighting, color temperature, material, or illustration style inconsistent across sections

fingerprints.correction: Define Asset DNA before producing any asset.

fingerprints.title: Fake technical HUD overlay
fingerprints.description: Sci-fi HUD elements, targeting reticles, scanning animations over content with no real data.
fingerprints.why_ai: Film-UI costume. No real data underneath.

detection.visual_signal: SVG/Canvas overlay with readout-style elements displaying no real data

fingerprints.correction: Remove. Design a real data interface if needed.
